title: Nokia to Lead European Robotics & Unmanned Technology Initiative
text:
Nokia has been chosen to lead PROACTIF, a major European Union initiative focused on advancing robotics and unmanned technologies across the continent. Backed by the EU’s Chips Joint Undertaking, the multimillion euro project is designed to boost Europe’s resilience and competitiveness in electronic components and systems while accelerating the strategic autonomy of its drone and robotics sectors.
As the lead coordinator, Nokia will drive innovation in unmanned vehicle technologies that address critical civil security challenges, including infrastructure monitoring and emergency response. Read more.
